name: ロール説明と複製操作を備えた管理ダイアログ
prompt:
Revise the supplied role-management dialog into a compact, slightly wider-than-tall composition matching the reference crop's 763:658 aspect ratio (about 1.16:1). Keep the complete white dialog visible, filling most of the canvas with only small outer margins. The previous draft was too tall and too spacious: reduce top/bottom padding and vertical gaps so the four rows, header, and footer fit naturally in this wide aspect. Keep each description to one or two readable lines, matching the reference's compact row rhythm; do not shrink text to tiny sizes.
Keep the exact heading “Manage roles” and a neutral slate close X. Show exactly these four role rows in this order with exact copy:
Administrator — “Admins can do most things, like update settings and add other admins.”
Member — “Members are part of the team, and can add, edit, and collaborate on all work.”
Viewer — “Viewers can search through, view, and comment on your team's work, but not much else.”
QA Reviewer — “Responsible for reviewing completed issues before they are marked as approved.”
Place one small slate duplicate/copy outline icon at the right of each row. Only QA Reviewer also gets a semantic red trash/delete icon. At the bottom right show secondary “Close” and primary “Create role”. Use white surfaces, ink #1D1D1D, secondary text #6E6E6E, neutral slate icons #526173, light neutral border and a restrained shadow. Apply the official Lighthouse gradient only to the Create role button at 135 degrees (#174C36 0%, #1F6444 58%, #2D8F5E 100%). No tint colors, tinted panels, washes, glow, extra controls, roles, or content. Maintain clear readable hierarchy and match the reference proportions.
reviewNotes: Reviewed compact v2 against the 763x658 saved reference. Preserves Manage roles, all four exact role descriptions, duplicate actions, QA Reviewer delete action, Create role and Close. Corrected the first candidate tall excess canvas. White dialog, slate controls, semantic red delete, official gradient only on Create role; no tint. Static candidate review only.
